tools.name: search_support_scenarios
tools.description: FREE. Find the right support scenario for a user's problem, in English or Chinese (e.g. "sent USDT on the wrong network", "忘填memo", "fake support DM", "seed phrase leaked"). Returns up to 5 scenario ids with titles and whether each is free.

tools.name: list_support_scenarios
tools.description: FREE. All 25 bilingual support scenarios (id, title, free or paid). Scenarios 01, 04, 11, 12, 22 are free; the rest unlock with one $5.00 USDC/USDT transfer.

tools.name: get_support_reply
tools.description: Returns the ready-to-send reply for one scenario: what to ask the user first, the reply in Chinese and in English, and an internal note for the agent. Scenarios 01, 04, 11, 12, 22 are FREE. Others return a preview plus payment instructions until you pass pay_tx: one plain transfer of >= $5.00 USDC/U

tools.name: payment_options
tools.description: FREE. Price ($5.00), receiving addresses and the exact USDC/USDT contracts accepted on each chain, and how to redeem with pay_tx. Plain transfer from any wallet or exchange withdrawal; no x402 client and no account needed.

tools.name: check_crypto_address
tools.description: FREE, offline. Before a user sends or a support agent confirms a deposit address: detects the address family (EVM, TRON, Bitcoin, Solana, TON, XRP, ...), validates checksum and format, cross-checks it against the intended network, flags missing memo/tag for exchange deposits and known token-contract

tools.name: check_address_poisoning
tools.description: FREE, offline. Compares a destination address with addresses the user already trusts (address book, past counterparties) and flags look-alikes that share the first and last characters but differ in the middle: the address-poisoning scam pattern.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_support_scenarios · Private data: payment_options, check_crypto_address · Public sink: get_support_reply, check_address_poisoning · Destructive: check_crypto_address.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_support_scenarios · Private data: payment_options, check_crypto_address · Public sink: get_support_reply, check_address_poisoning · Destructive: check_crypto_address

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
